title: Production administrator authority
text: A *-db-admin connection runs each handler on the operator's machine against the database over a tunnel, 10-75x slower than its paired https env. Routine operations use --env <https env>; any other registered call through the door refuses use_https_env and names that env. The door keeps only db read diagnostics, doctor, migration content identity, operator data repair, migration rehearsal, driving a self-deploy of the paired API, creation bootstrap and an explicitly selected admin merge, listed once in yoke_contracts.direct_database_access. A self-deploy driver still sends each call to the paired https env first, one attempt, and runs it through the door only when that env cannot serve it (no connection, the API down or mid-replacement, or a serving build lacking the function), printing a one-line note.
